text:
maria_cs: Morning — kicking off a short ops scrub for Seaborne Labs' private deployment. They want CMK + audit logs to an analytics account and low-latency egress. Can we list day0 blockers?

devon_net: Hi — network checklist: VPC peering vs Transit, NAT throughput, route tables, and whether they need VPC endpoints for S3/CloudWatch. Also need public egress IPs for Splunk forwarder whitelist.

sophie_security: From security side: retention window for audit logs, key rotation cadence, and cross-account role constraints. Any regulatory requirements?

maria_cs: Customer note: 7-year retention for audit artifacts (HIPAA-ish), prefer customer-owned key, and long-term analytics live in a separate AWS account.

raj_kms: For CMK cross-account decrypt we can create a key policy granting the analytics account a decrypt role and a separate IAM role for Redwood to use. Will need their principal ARN. Example policy snippet below.

raj_kms: ```json
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {"Sid": "Allow account 123456789012 to use key", "Effect": "Allow", "Principal": {"AWS": "arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/SeaborneAnalyticsRole"}, "Action": ["kms:Decrypt","kms:GenerateDataKey*"], "Resource": "*"}
  ]
}
```

sam_engineer: For logs: we recommend streaming CloudWatch logs to Kinesis Firehose -> S3 in analytics account with server-side encryption using their CMK. Need to confirm S3 bucket policy to allow PutObject from our Firehose role (cross-account).

devon_net: About egress: if they need static IPs, we can use NAT GW with Elastic IPs or an Egress-only VPC endpoint (if IPv6). Splunk wants three IPs whitelisted. Do they want redundancy across AZs?

tim_seaborne: Yes — Seaborne confirms 3 IPs for Splunk, wants multi-AZ failover. They can supply the analytics account ID: 987654321000.

maria_cs: Great. Action items so far: (1) Get analytics account principal ARN for KMS policy (Raj) (2) Confirm EIP allocation plan for NAT (Devon) (3) Provide S3 bucket policy template for cross-account Firehose (Sam) (4) Retention SLAs + export playbook for 7-year retention (Sophie).

raj_kms: Noted. Raj will draft CMK policy and a brief rotate/backup doc. One question: do they require symmetric CMK only or do they want asymmetric (sign/verify)?

tim_seaborne: Symmetric is fine. Rotation annual ok. Also they asked about key import/export restrictions — they cannot import external key material.

sam_engineer: Putting together S3 policy template now. Will include kms:Encrypt condition and a statement to allow our Firehose role from account 481000000000.

devon_net: I'll sketch NAT + route table plan. Proposing one NAT GW per AZ with EIPs, RouteTables pointing private subnets to local AZ NAT for low cross-AZ latency. If they want lower cost we can discuss NAT gateway autoscaling with managed fleet.

sophie_security: For retention/export: recommend daily immutable snapshots to separate archival bucket with MFA delete + lifecycle to Glacier Deep Archive. Also we should capture proof-of-delivery for compliance — we'll surface a runbook for legal.

maria_cs: Thanks — two meta items: (A) I'm flagging renewal-risk if audit/retention isn't validated within 30 days (customer said compliance gating cutover). (B) We'll run a cutover dry-run once KMS + log streaming are configured.

ops_bot: Reminder: create ticket CS-8472 for Seaborne day0 tasks and schedule a follow-up in 48h.

tim_seaborne: Quick clarifying Q: will Redwood have access to decrypt logs for troubleshooting or will decrypt only be allowed to the analytics account?

raj_kms: We can allow a scoped, time-limited role for Redwood with kms:Decrypt for support sessions. Prefer using IAM condition `aws:MultiFactorAuthPresent` + session tag. Will draft that in policy.

maria_cs: Perfect. I'll collect all drafts and send to Seaborne by EOD. If anyone sees a missing blocker, ping me here. :thumbsup:
